extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed bounded mechanism ontology. Direct mechanism labels are used only where primary figures/text/source data provide direct membrane, phospholipid-binding, or liposome-lysis assays; broader interpretation remains guarded.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CpoBD13 permeabilises C. albicans membranes in a concentration-dependent and pH-dependent manner.
direct_assay_types: live microscopy with CpoBD13-BODIPY and PI
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is bounded to membrane permeabilisation/targeting in the assayed fungal system; no broader host-immune mechanism is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CpoBD13 binds phosphatidic acid and preferentially lyses PA-containing liposomes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Liposome experiments support PA targeting and membrane lysis in model membranes, not a complete in-cell structural pathway by themselves.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Histidine-mediated PA binding and environmental pH modulate CpoBD13 antifungal membrane activity.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The role of oligomerisation as a required in-cell step is left cautious because the paper itself notes this remains unclear.
